title: PDV Phase 20 Nord broad Old Ways, Kyne, and Talos implementation costing
designRules: Broad worship is a STATE (PDV_State_NordPantheonBaseline: OldWays|NineDivines), not a deity; broad lane caps at Faithful (T2) and never reaches T3.
Focused patron devotion must be stronger, sharper, and narrower than broad Old Ways or broad Nine Divines; suppress broad T2 favors when a patron is focused.

Nord can FOCUS ANY GOD IN ITS CHOSEN PANTHEON (decision 2026-06-07; supersedes the retired 'Nord owns zero new deities / broad-only Shor/Tsun/Stuhn'). Old Ways lane = Kyne(reuse) + Talos(reuse) + Shor/Tsun/Stuhn(NEW, Nord-owned QUSTs, create:true, Stance_Nord NATIVE). Nine Divines lane = the 8 Divines(reuse, Imperial-owned; Nord reconciles Stance_Nord only) + Talos(reuse). Hircine routes through the Phase 20C Daedric system, not a new Aedric record.
Pantheon baseline and shared patron state stay separate; do not implement Broad/Primary as Nord baseline states.
Talos pressure requires costly faithful signals, not generic anti-Thalmor violence or ordinary Civil War preference.

Kyne/Talos/Shor/Tsun/Stuhn/Divines/Hircine/broad must not stack into a universal best build; only one focus is active at a time; broad blended favors at Faithful stay softer than Devoted patron benefits.
Each new Nord-owned deity QUST (Shor/Tsun/Stuhn) needs the SGE flag + a SEQ entry (the BaanDar lesson).
Reuse the existing Kyne neglect spell (PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Kyne / SyncKyneNeglectSpell); do not create a new Nord neglect spell.

notes: Setup framing only; selects which pantheon's gods are offer-eligible and shifts theological naming/moral framing.
Broad lane (OldWays default) runs on PATRON_STATE_BROAD and the FIXED broad-T1 manager property PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T1; the new broad-T2 is PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T2 (capped at Faithful).
Commitment depth is the SHARED patron state (PDV_GLO_PatronState / PDV_GLO_PatronDeity), not a Nord baseline state. Do not implement Broad/Primary here.
Shared broad-vs-active-patron state; the dawn-only Nord offer gate moves the player from broad worship to an active focused patron (Kyne or Talos in V1).
Accepting a primary offer sets active primary, stores the deity in PDV_GLO_PatronDeity, clears pending Nord candidates, and applies 70% piety carry-over.
No competing primary offers fire in 1.0 while an active primary is set; decay below T3 weakens but does not auto-clear.
Stores the committed focused patron (PDV_Deity_Kyne or PDV_Deity_Talos in V1).
Focused-patron rewards gate on this plus the patron's piety tier; suppresses broad T2 favors while focus is active.

creedViolationLoss.policy: Medium/major only; 2-3 negative deltas. Not the same as neglect drift.

entries.trigger: Killing a tamed/sacred beast or wanton beast slaughter against Kyne's beast-calm domain.
entries.note: Reuses the existing Kyne -3.0 beast-kill delta; not a new mechanism.

entries.trigger: Reporting/betraying a Talos worshipper, surrendering a hidden shrine, or public compliance after focused Talos commitment.
entries.note: Compliance never grants Talos favor and, after focus, reads as betrayal (medium loss).

entries.trigger: Aiding the Thalmor against Talos faith in a major authored beat after Talos focus.
entries.note: Major creed loss; never fires from ordinary Civil War preference.

neglect.note: Kyne neglect is ALREADY wired on PDV__ManagerQuest. Do NOT create a new Nord neglect spell. Talos neglect texture is fiction-only in V1 (no dedicated spell); broad-worship neglect is gentle drift via the daily consolidation system, not a spell.

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Skyrim itself notices old roads, weather, holds, Talos pressure, and chosen patron life; broad Old Ways feels culturally complete at Faithful before any patron commits.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Broad Old Ways/Nine Divines favors are blended, soft, and culturally normal; the dawn offer turns sustained playstyle into a focused patron without a shrine pilgrimage.
Kyne signals read as weather/sky/road/hunt; Talos signals read as costly hidden defiance; neither comes from generic travel, kills, or anti-Thalmor violence.
feedbackSurface: Pantheon baseline and Survey/status copy explain broad/focused state, primary patron, Kyne/Talos/Hircine tension, vampire/scar state, and active favor.
Top-left notification or proven toast feedback only; no forced full Prisma panel; T3 recognition is V1 Survey text only (voiced lines are V2).
rejectedGenericBehavior: broad worship inheriting every patron boon
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A broad Nord feels noticed through weather, honor, hearth, death, Talos pressure, and hold identity without needing to accept a patron; ~12 days to Devoted once a patron is focused (the reference pace).
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Before any reward expansion, prove broad/focused state readout, one Kyne or Talos focused context, the Hircine/werewolf edge audit, generic dense-hook rejection, and expected/edge stack snapshots.

rules: broad lane is a STATE (PDV_State_NordPantheonBaseline) using FIXED PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T1 and new PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T2; no PDV_Deity_OldWays/NineDivines record exists

Nord owns exactly THREE new deity records (Shor/Tsun/Stuhn, create:true, Stance_Nord NATIVE, Old Ways focusable, each with SGE flag + SEQ entry); Kyne and Talos resolve as existing reused records (create:false); the 8 Divines resolve as Imperial-owned reused records with Stance_Nord reconciled (create:false); Hircine is not a new Aedric record

Nord can focus any god in its chosen pantheon (Old Ways: Kyne/Talos/Shor/Tsun/Stuhn; Nine Divines: 8 Divines + Talos); each focusable god carries a PDV_Bless_Nord_<God>_T1/T2/T3 family; only one focus active at a time
broad T2 favors are suppressed when a focused patron is active; broad never reaches T3
Kyne neglect reuses PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Kyne / SyncKyneNeglectSpell; no new Nord neglect spell is created
rejected hook families (generic kill/travel/tomb/anti-Thalmor, broad-inherits-all, Daedric menu) are converted into verifier or runtime negative cases
no reward magnitude exceeds ~12%; player text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names

positive: a broad Old Ways (or Nine Divines) Nord reaches Faithful through weather/honor/hearth/death/Talos with blended soft favors
the dawn offer fires for any god in the active pantheon lane (Old Ways: Kyne/Talos/Shor/Tsun/Stuhn; Nine Divines: a Divine or Talos) from sustained playstyle and applies 70% carry-over on acceptance
a focused patron (any pantheon god) gets sharper, narrower rewards while broad T2 favors are suppressed
Hircine/werewolf edge adds priced pressure without freely stacking onto the focused patron
negative: generic kills, travel, tomb clears, and anti-Thalmor violence do not score Nord favor
broad worship does not inherit every individual patron boon and never reaches T3
compliance never grants Talos favor; ordinary Civil War preference does not trigger defiance favor
an offer for an out-of-lane god does not fire (Old Ways gods are not offer-eligible under Nine Divines and vice versa)
more than one focus is never active at once; focused patron + Hircine + broad do not stack into a universal best build

firstImplementationSlice: Create the 3 new Nord-owned deity QUSTs (Shor/Tsun/Stuhn; Stance_Nord NATIVE; SGE flag + SEQ entry each) and reconcile Stance_Nord on the 8 Imperial Divines (create:false).

Author the new broad-T2 PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T2 capped at Faithful, plus the Old Ways focused T1/T2/T3 sets (Kyne/Shor/Tsun/Stuhn/Talos) and the Nine Divines per-god Nord families (PDV_Bless_Nord_<God>_T1/T2/T3).
Wire broad-T2 suppression under active focus, lane-eligibility on offers, one-active-focus, and confirm broad never reaches T3.
Confirm Kyne neglect reuse (PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Kyne) and add the Kyne beast-kill / Talos-betrayal creed-loss deltas (medium/major only).
Add negative tests for generic kill/travel/tomb/anti-Thalmor, broad-inherits-all-patron-boons, out-of-lane offers, and free focused/Hircine/broad stacking.
